name: Storm Catcher
ability: Name a good character. If in play, they can only die by execution, but evil players learn which player it is.
setup: The Storyteller names a good character at the start; if in play, that player is marked SAFE.
wakes: Each evil player is woken on the first night to learn the result. Night order: no number on the townsquare scale used by these specs (townsquare gives every Traveller a placeholder 1, and Fabled none); the official app nightsheet places it very early, before the Townsfolk (first night 5 of 80).
interaction: First night: each evil player is shown whether the named character is in play and, if so, which player it is.
drunk_or_poisoned: Fabled cannot be drunk or poisoned.

rulings.text: The named character need not be in play; evil then learns it is not in play and can bluff it.
Protection applies to every death except execution.
Only good characters can be named.
The wiki classifies it as Loric rather than Fabled.

test_scenarios.name: survives night kills
test_scenarios.setup: Storm Catcher names General; Alice General, Bob Imp, Carol Godfather.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Bob attacks Alice. Night 3: Carol's Godfather kill targets Alice.

test_scenarios.name: dies by execution
test_scenarios.setup: Storm Catcher names General; Alice General.

test_scenarios.name: evil learns
test_scenarios.setup: Storm Catcher names Empath; Alice Empath, Bob Imp, Carol Poisoner.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob and Carol each learn that Alice is the Empath.

test_scenarios.name: not in play
test_scenarios.setup: Storm Catcher names Empath; no Empath in play.
test_scenarios.expected: Evil players learn the Empath is not in play.
